name: Ywain
source:
"People who treat me like a kid can fuck off."

Based on Ywain, who is a Knight of the Round Table and the son of King Urien in Arthurian legend. Ywain was one of the earliest characters associated with King Arthur, and one of the most popular.

One of the Knights of the Round Table. Though young, Ywain makes it up with her talent: her combat skills are on par with Gawain's. Naive and energetic, Ywain owns a pet lion called Laudine and she is often seen on its back. Whenever Ywain gets mad, she surprises her opponents by starting to curse and use other bad words, especially in English. Dislikes being treated like a kid, which is why she hates training with others because they always hold back when they fight her.
